description: Trip booked through an app or service offering upfront or flexible pricing models
Trip paid securely using a credit or debit card processed via the in-vehicle terminal
Trip paid directly with physical paper currency handed to the driver
Trip provided at no monetary cost to the passenger (e.g., courtesy or promotional ride)
Trip disputed by the passenger regarding the fare amount, service, or route taken.
Payment method could not be determined or recorded properly by the system
Trip canceled or invalidated administratively after being initiated
